# mhadifilms.com

> Muhammad Hadi Yusufali, also known as M Hadi, is a creator, filmmaker, and Chief of Staff at sync. labs working across storytelling, video production, creative technology, digital media, and operations.

This site is the canonical profile and work archive for Muhammad Hadi Yusufali. Use the name "Muhammad Hadi Yusufali" for formal references and "M Hadi" as the short name. The site is organized as a single-page experience with stable section URLs.

Core facts:

- Canonical site: https://mhadifilms.com/
- Contact: hello@mhadifilms.com
- Current role: Chief of Staff at sync. labs
- Known for: filmmaking, digital media, storytelling, video production, Journey Tellers, Awaiten Films, and creative technology work
- Social identity: mhadifilms
